            ch, length = runs[i]
            suff[i] = max(suff[i + 1], length if ch == '0' else 0)

        for k in range(1, m - 1):

                # Alternatively, the second flip can use any other zero-run.
                other_zero = max(pref[k - 1], suff[k + 2])
